resources.string: A shared picture could not be read.
Saving and sharing need a newer Android System WebView. Update it from your app store and try again.
The page stopped unexpectedly and was reloaded. Choose your pictures again.
The photo could not be taken. Try again.
The photo could not be prepared. Try again.
The camera could not start. Another app may be using it. Close that app and try again.
The camera is turned off on this device, in its settings or by whoever manages it.

To take a photo here, MetadataScrubber needs your permission to use the camera. If Android asks, its question also mentions video: the app only takes photos. The photo is made without a location or device details and stays inside the app until you save, share or copy it. It is not added to your gallery. The app has no internet access, so it cannot send the photo anywhere.

MetadataScrubber is not allowed to use the camera. To take photos in the app, open its settings, tap Permissions, then Camera, and allow it. Choosing pictures and sharing them into the app work without it.
